name: QFA 358 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 358, from SIA to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10,100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625, contact Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 358，从 SIA 飞往武汉。你正保持 10,100 米飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3625，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, maintaining 1100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，正保持 1,100 米飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 6300 meters at your discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，武汉管制，雷达识别，可自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6300 meters at our discretion, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, our weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 358, Negative heading 050 due to restricted area.
B: Tell Wuhan control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before you can resume course.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： QFA 358，因限制区，不能使用航向 050。
B： 告诉武汉管制，你希望保持航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后才能恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, request heading 030 for at least five minutes
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，请求保持航向 030 至少 5 分钟。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, roger, heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，收到，批准航向 030，脱离天气后直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准右转航向 030，脱离天气后直飞 LKO，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, ATIS B received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，已收到 ATIS B，现在联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, Wuhan approach, LKO-2A arrival, descent to and maintain 1,200 meters, information C is now current, you are number l.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，武汉进近，执行 LKO-2A 进场，下降至并保持 1,200 米，当前情报为 C，你是第一架落地航空器。
cards.referenceText: LKO two A arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, information C, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 LKO-2A 进场，下降至并保持 1,200 米，C 情报，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中你的气象雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求航路沿线天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, our weather radar has failed during descent, request weather information along our route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达在下降过程中失效，请求航路沿线天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, roger, our weather radar shows cumulonimbus in the vicinity of DA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，收到，我们的气象雷达显示 DA 附近有积雨云。

cards.audioText: Request Wuhan approach for radar assistance to intercept final course of Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉进近请求雷达引导，以切入 Runway 36L 最后进近航道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, request radar vectors to intercept final course Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，请求雷达引导切入 Runway 36L 最后进近航道。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer RWY 36 Left, contact tower124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，左转航向 030，下降至并保持 600 米，许可切入 Runway 36L 航向道，联系塔台 124.35。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer Runway 36L, 124.35, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，下降至并保持 600 米，许可切入 Runway 36L 航向道，124.35，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You encountered the downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, informed Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在短五边遭遇下沉气流并执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 358, we encountered the downdrafts on short final, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 358，我们在短五边遭遇下沉气流，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, roger, when able, Turn right heading 090, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，收到，可以时右转航向 090，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.7。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan approach 119.7, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.7，QFA 358。
